# Clínicas La Guardia

> A specialized dental clinic in Panajachel, Guatemala offering comprehensive restorative, cosmetic, and preventive dental care with advanced 3D imaging technology.

Clínicas La Guardia is a modern dental practice founded by Dr. Chepe Lemus, providing expert services ranging from dental implants and orthodontics to endodontics and pediatric dentistry. The clinic combines cutting-edge diagnostic technology with personalized patient care.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Orthodontics
- Endodontics
- Fixed Prosthetics
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- 3D Radiography
- Digital X-rays
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Dental Veneers & Crowns
- Dental Restoration
- Patient Care
- Panajachel Guatemala
- Preventive Dentistry
- Smile Alignment
- Advanced Diagnostics

## Core Services

- [Dental Services Overview](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios): Comprehensive dental services overview: implants, prosthetics, orthodontics, and restorative treatments
- [Dental Implants](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/implantes-dentales): Immediate-load dental implants and complete prosthetics solutions for tooth replacement
- [Orthodontics](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/ortodoncia): Smile alignment treatments including brackets, aligners, and comprehensive orthodontic care
- [Endodontics](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/endodoncia): Expert root canal treatment for pain relief and tooth preservation
- [Fixed Prosthetics](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/protesis-fija): Fixed dental prosthetics and bridges for comprehensive smile restoration

## Cosmetic & Restoration

- [Veneers & Crowns](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/carillas-y-coronas): Dental veneers and crowns for smile enhancement with pricing and restoration options

## Diagnostic & Preventive

- [Advanced Radiographic Diagnosis](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/diagnostico-radiologico): Advanced 3D digital X-rays and radiographic imaging for accurate dental diagnosis
- [Dental Cleaning](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/limpieza-dental): Professional dental cleaning and oral hygiene with preventive care focus

## Specialized Care

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://clinicaslaguardia.com/servicios/odontopeditria): Specialized dental care for children with a focus on comfort and preventive treatment
